data.title: Thailand to 'stay neutral' in US-China AI race
data.description: Thailand would maintain its neutral position between the United States and China and resist pressure to choose sides in the global race for artificial intelligence (AI), Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Monday.

data.title: PM denies staging stop in Buri Ram
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has denied suggestions that a police inspection of his vehicle in Buri Ram was staged, saying officers were simply performing their duties at a routine checkpoint.

data.title: Marine agency AI art contest sparks backlash
data.description: Strong criticisms were lobbed at the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources after it announced the results of an AI art contest held to mark National Dugong Conservation Day on Monday, with the winning image showing a dugong with what appeared to be four legs.

data.title: Fake tax invoice gang busted, 3 arrests
data.description: Economic crimes police have arrested three people allegedly involved a network that issued and sold fake tax invoices, costing the state 360 million baht in lost revenue, the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) announced on Monday.

data.title: Former Thai national swimmer found dead on Saraburi canal-side
data.description: A former Thai national swimmer who had been missing for two days was found dead in a wooded area beside an irrigation canal in Saraburi province on Sunday.

data.title: 15th Thai soldier maimed by landmine along Cambodian border
data.description: UBON RATCHATHANI - A Thai soldier lost his leg when he stepped on a landmine during mine clearance on Monday in this northeastern province bordering Cambodia.

data.title: Proxy companies probe expands into Northeast
data.description: The Interior Ministry has expanded its investigation into foreign-owned proxy companies to Sakon Nakhon, while a senior Phuket official has proposed the government stop providing welfare benefits for foreign workers who give birth at public hospitals.

data.title: Local man arrested for theft of fighting cocks, farm produce
data.description: BURIRAM - Police have arrested a 29-year-old man following a series of thefts targeting fighting cocks, farm produce and household goods in Chaloem Phra Kiat district.

data.title: Nene Royal wows Phuket ahead of America’s Got Talent performance
data.description: PHUKET - Young Thai rocker Rattikarn Amloy, known as Nene Royal, and her band Ozone performed at the market where they had formerly busked on Sunday night, ahead of her trip to the United States to compete in the Live Shows round of America’s Got Talent (AGT).

data.title: Couple and 30 cats die in Nonthaburi housefire
data.description: NONTHABURI - A couple and about 30 pet cats died in a house fire in the early hours of Monday and rescuers later found a charcoal stove and petrol container in the bedroom.

data.title: Govt confident in maritime border talks
data.description: <p>Thailand is confident the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos) conciliation process over its maritime boundary dispute with Cambodia will proceed smoothly after Australian diplomat Katrina Cooper was appointed as the fifth conciliator and chair of the Conciliation Commission.</p>

data.title: Ministry seeks nod for  southern double-track plan
data.description: <p>The Transport Ministry will seek cabinet approval next month for a 106.8-billion-baht plan to build about 504 kilometres of double-track railway from Chumphon to the Malaysian border.</p>

data.title: NHSO faces gold card reform calls
data.description: <p>For more than 20 years, Thailand's universal healthcare scheme has stood as one of the country's most significant social welfare achievements, providing medical care for almost 50 million people.</p>

data.title: Karon a 'model area' for landslide risk assessment
data.description: <p>Phuket: Tambon Karon in Muang district of this resort province, where a major landslide in August 2024 killed 13 people, has been selected as a model area for assessing landslide risks and developing measures to protect residents, tourists and critical infrastructure.</p>

data.title: BMA pushes strict alcohol regulations
data.description: <p>The Thai Health Promotion Foundation (ThaiHealth) and Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) are stepping up efforts to raise public awareness of stricter alcohol controls, urging retailers and communities to help prevent sales to people under 20 and those who are visibly intoxicated.</p>

data.title: BJT demands proof of poll fraud claims
data.description: <p>The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) is unfazed by the opposition's planned no-confidence debate, saying allegations of fraud in the Senate election must be backed by evidence.</p>

data.title: New school design  'can limit casualties'
data.description: <p>A Thammasat University study has proposed changes to school buildings and grounds that it says could help reduce casualties in mass shootings by slowing attackers and giving students and staff more time to escape or take shelter.</p>

data.title: Thailand eyes Dawei port role
data.description: <p>Thailand is positioning itself as a key player in the proposed Dawei deep-sea port project in Myanmar, as Russia expresses interest in investing in major infrastructure projects in the region, including the long-delayed port.</p>

data.title: Hopes pinned on Si Sa Ket wat
data.description: <p>Si Sa Ket, a relatively low-profile tourist destination, is being positioned for greater attention through a tourism push centred on cultural, spiritual and natural attractions.</p>

data.title: Students take home 4 medals
data.description: Thai students have won four medals at International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) 2026 in Uzbekistan, the Promotion of Teaching Science and Technology (IPST) says.

data.title: Cabinet nod gets Hat Yai monorail on track
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) is set to advance Songkhla province’s Hat Yai monorail project after the cabinet approved its authority to operate rail services in the province.

data.title: Falling tree injures 4 Spaniards at Ayutthaya historical park
data.description: PHRA NAKHON SI AYUTTHAYA - A large flame tree collapsed in the grounds of historical Wat Phra Si Sanphet temple on Sunday, injuring four Spanish tourists - one seriously.

data.title: 'Wanted' Chinese fraudster arrested in Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - Police have arrested a 30-year-old Chinese man wanted by authorities in China for alleged fraud and money laundering, and he will be extradited to his homeland.
